{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue'] == 999999.99
num_qa_orders = qa_mask.sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders identified: {num_qa_orders}")

# Filter out QA orders
sales_clean = sales[~qa_mask]

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales_clean[(sales_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales_clean['status'] == 'completed')]
num_loyal_completed = len(loyal_completed)
print(f"Number of LOYAL completed orders after removing QA orders: {num_loyal_completed}")

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from LOYAL customers (after removing QA orders): {mean_revenue}")

# Return values for evidence
num_qa_orders, num_loyal_completed, mean_revenue"}
